title: A brief per item for the agent that works it
goal: backlog.py brief ID prints the packs of the item's asks and the text of its referenced facts, with their path:line and source urls, within a token budget; /kb-item and /kb-sprint put it in the working agent's brief.

gates.question: Build the brief command and the skill changes, given the measurement in kb/_self/reports/backlog-briefs.md?
options: drop the brief, keep asks and research tasks
gates.recommendation: build only if the with-brief arm used fewer tokens in every run
gates.answer: build if the with-brief arm used fewer tokens and had no more refused dones than the arm without it in every run; otherwise drop the brief and keep asks and research tasks; kb/_self/reports/backlog-briefs.md states which held

notes: With 'Verdict: drop' in the report this item's check cannot pass: drop it (backlog.py drop).
